pairs.a: The conference room in the old customs house was set up for talks about peace.
pairs.b: The conference room in the old customs house was set up for talks about war.

pairs.a: The lamps were lit early one December evening during a long stretch of peace.
pairs.b: The lamps were lit early one December evening during a long stretch of war.

pairs.a: Thick fog rolled over the valley, muffling every sound in the long years of peace.
pairs.b: Thick fog rolled over the valley, muffling every sound in the long years of war.

pairs.a: Yesterday a messenger arrived with papers announcing a new peace between the two governments.
pairs.b: Yesterday a messenger arrived with papers announcing a new war between the two governments.

pairs.a: Three elders sat by the fire, arguing about whether the treaty would bring peace.
pairs.b: Three elders sat by the fire, arguing about whether the treaty would bring war.
